status: experimental - not a validated clinical outcome assessment

tasks.name: Single target selection
tasks.construct: Basic pointing and selection: can the user move to and select one target.
tasks.rationale: Lowest-demand primitive; floor task for severe impairment; reaction and movement onset.
tasks.stimuli: Start button at canvas centre, then one circular target at random direction, distance D in {200, 350} px, width W in {80, 120} px.
tasks.timing: Stimulus onset = target shown (marker stimulus_on). MT = onset to terminating selection. Max 20 s per trial (configurable).
tasks.errors: Selection outside the target = error (ends trial). Timeout = no selection by max time.
tasks.completion: 12 trials or 6 minutes, whichever first; participant may pause at any time.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Large targets; no time pressure by default; works with click, dwell, switch-activated click; keyboard alternative Space/Enter at the cursor.

tasks.name: Multidirectional target acquisition (ISO-style ring)
tasks.rationale: Follows the ISO 9241-411 multidirectional tapping paradigm so throughput is comparable to the HCI literature; varying D and W gives a range of difficulty.
tasks.stimuli: 13 circular targets equally spaced on a circle of diameter D; the highlighted target alternates across the circle. D in {256, 512} px, W in {32, 64, 96} px (IDs 1.9-4.1 bits); conditions counterbalanced by seed.
tasks.timing: Sequential: MT = time between successive selections (first selection of each sequence starts the clock and is not scored). Max 15 s per selection.
tasks.errors: Selection outside the highlighted target = miss (counts in We; trial ends).
tasks.completion: 6 conditions x 13 selections; ~3-6 min with mouse.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Smallest W (32 px) can be excluded via the accessibility profile (target_min_px); throughput then computed only over administered conditions.

tasks.name: Dwell selection
tasks.construct: Selection by holding the pointer still (gaze / head-pointer style).
tasks.rationale: Dwell is the dominant selection method for eye-gaze and many head-pointer users; isolates stability (holding still) from clicking.
tasks.stimuli: Same geometry as A2 with D=384, W in {64, 96}; dwell threshold configurable (default 800 ms).
tasks.timing: MT includes the dwell time; dwell resets when the pointer leaves the item.
tasks.errors: Dwell completed on a non-target item = unintended selection (Midas-touch error).
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Dwell threshold and visual dwell-progress indicator configurable.

tasks.name: Selection among distractors (grid)
tasks.construct: Choosing one item among many: the core of on-screen keyboards, menus and communication boards.
tasks.rationale: Allows achieved-bitrate (penalised for errors) comparable to BCI grid tasks.
tasks.stimuli: Grid of R x C square items (default 4 x 6, 120 px cells, 100 px items); one cued item per trial; cue sequence from seed.
tasks.timing: MT = cue onset to selection; max 20 s.
tasks.errors: Selecting a non-cued item = wrong selection (ends trial). Empty-space clicks are counted but do not end the trial.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Cell size configurable; scanning order for switch users.

tasks.name: Time-constrained acquisition
tasks.construct: Ability to act within a deadline (e.g. answering a prompt in time).
tasks.rationale: Real interfaces impose time limits (call answer, dialog timeout); success-within-deadline is interpretable for function.
tasks.stimuli: As A1 with deadline in {2000, 4000} ms.
tasks.errors: No selection by deadline = timeout error.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Off by default for participants whose profile sets 'no time pressure' (WCAG 2.2.1 adjustable timing).

tasks.name: Straight-line steering (tunnel)
tasks.construct: Constrained movement along a path (steering law).
tasks.rationale: Captures path control that aimed pointing does not (e.g. dragging along menus).
tasks.stimuli: Horizontal tunnel of length 600 px, width in {40, 80} px; start and end zones.
tasks.timing: MT = leaving the start zone to entering the end zone.
tasks.errors: Leaving the tunnel = exit error (trial continues; count reported).
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

tasks.name: Continuous tracking
tasks.construct: Continuous closed-loop control; sensitive to latency and smoothing.
tasks.rationale: Discrete selections can hide latency; tracking exposes it directly (lag).
tasks.stimuli: Target moves on a sum-of-sines path (0.1-0.4 Hz components), 30 s per trial; target radius 40 px.
tasks.timing: Sampled at display rate; first 3 s excluded.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Speed scale configurable; reduced-motion profiles substitute a slower path.

tasks.name: Scroll to target
tasks.rationale: Scrolling is one of the commonest real digital actions and uses a different control mapping (rate control) from pointing.
tasks.stimuli: Vertical list of 60 items (60 px rows) in a 400 px viewport; cued item must be brought into the highlighted band and selected; direction up or down.
tasks.timing: Time from cue to selection; max 30 s.
tasks.errors: Selecting while the cued item is outside the band = error.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Scroll by wheel, scroll buttons (for switch / dwell), or keys.

tasks.name: Drag object to zone
tasks.construct: Selecting, holding and relocating an object (hold-state reliability).
tasks.rationale: Dragging requires sustained selection; BCI click decoders and dwell systems often struggle with holds.
tasks.stimuli: Object (60 px) at start; drop zone width in {80, 160} px at D=400 px.
tasks.timing: Time from cue to successful drop; max 30 s.
tasks.errors: Release outside the zone = drop error (object stays; participant re-grabs).
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Drag-lock mode (click to pick up, click to drop) available for users who cannot hold.

tasks.name: Copy typing (on-screen keyboard)
tasks.rationale: Communication is the highest-value outcome for people with paralysis; copy typing gives a controlled, content-free measure (no private text).
tasks.stimuli: Presented phrases from NeuroMetric's original phrase set (short, common, lowercase); on-screen QWERTY keyboard with space and backspace; pointer or scanning.
tasks.timing: Clock starts at first keystroke; ends at the Done key or time limit (3 min/phrase).
tasks.errors: Uncorrected errors (MSD) and corrected errors (IF) reported separately.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: Key size, scanning rate and dwell configurable; no free text is stored.

tasks.name: Structured phrase selection
tasks.construct: Message selection from a set (AAC-style communication).
tasks.rationale: Many AAC users communicate via phrase/word selection rather than spelling.
tasks.stimuli: Board of 12 phrases; spoken/written cue names the phrase to select.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

tasks.name: Select a contact (simulated)
tasks.construct: Simulated digital activity: find and open a contact.
tasks.rationale: Ecological composite of scroll + select; in-app only, no real contacts.
tasks.stimuli: Simulated contact list (fictional names) with 20 entries; target named in cue.
tasks.errors: Opening the wrong contact = error; 'back' returns.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.
tasks.accessibility: All controls reachable by keyboard / scanning.

tasks.name: Compose a predefined message (simulated)
tasks.construct: Communication activity: open a conversation and send a predefined message composed from tiles.
tasks.stimuli: Open messages -> choose recipient -> select 3 message tiles -> press send.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

tasks.name: Menu navigation (simulated)
tasks.stimuli: Menu bar with 5 menus x 6 items; target named in cue.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

tasks.construct: Schedule an appointment: pick a date, a time slot, confirm.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

tasks.name: Form completion (simulated)
tasks.construct: Fill a short form with predefined choices (no personal data).
tasks.rationale: Forms are ubiquitous in health portals and daily admin.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

tasks.name: Communication board (simulated)
tasks.construct: Express a predefined need using a symbol/word board (AAC).
tasks.stimuli: 4 x 5 board of words; build a 3-word message.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

tasks.name: Simulated browser navigation
tasks.construct: Follow a link on a simulated web page and find a named item.
tasks.rationale: Web use is a key participation activity.
tasks.assistance: Assistance is recorded as ASSIST events (setup, physical, verbal, troubleshooting, calibration, task_completion) by the participant, care partner or staff via the assistance panel; any assistance during a trial marks it 'assisted', never 'failed'.

excluded.name: Obstacle navigation
excluded.reason: Overlaps with B1 steering and A4 selection among distractors; adds layout complexity without a distinct construct. Kept as a web demo only.

excluded.name: Free text entry
excluded.reason: Requires storing personal text; offered only with explicit consent and never stored by default (character counts and timing only).
